scope: Reused individual proposal assessments with matching current hashes; reread all 50 deletion targets and six merge cards, including saved summaries and formulation caveats. Primary sources were checked for merge scope; prior later-result checks were reused. This is not a new full literature or proof audit of every question.

deferred_consolidations.TCS-0133: Align probabilistic containment and finite-ambiguity conventions with TCS-3863.
deferred_consolidations.TCS-0171: Align constants, empty words and equation-system conventions with TCS-0163; RTA Problem 92 checked at https://www.cs.tau.ac.il/~nachum/rtaloop/problems/92.html.
deferred_consolidations.TCS-6953: Map worst-case, average-case, one-wayness and trapdoor branches separately; no single retained card is claimed equivalent to the bundle.
deferred_consolidations.TCS-7033: Preserve the arc branch and record parameter-preserving reductions before consolidation with the vertex-kernel target.
deferred_consolidations.TCS-2783: All sufficiently large n and arbitrarily large n are different quantifiers. The girth endpoints also differ; do not silently discard either distinction.
deferred_consolidations.TCS-6937: Integer word models and the comparison-addition real RAM are different; a shared exponent theme does not prove equivalent formulations.
